title: New Customer offers New customer (this customer) before a name is typed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. Click the "Bill Invoices To" field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Bill Invoices To" field reads "This customer".

Step 2:

  • The first option reads "New customer (this customer)".
  • Other customers follow, A to Z.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R4: “In New Customer, the first option reads "[name typed so far] (this customer)", or "New customer (this customer)" before a name is typed.”
